parameters.content:
## 📥 INTAKE
Gmail trigger watches the shared inbox.
Auto-replies are filtered out automatically.
Message data is normalized and body truncated to 3k chars.

## 🔍 DEDUPLICATION
Searches Airtable by Message-ID.
If found → stop (prevents reprocessing on poll overlap).
If new → log with status "Processing" before AI call.

## 🤖 AI AGENT
Single agent call returns structured JSON:
→ Category (6 options)
→ Confidence (0-100)
→ Human review flag
→ Reasoning
→ Draft response

Chat Model: GPT-4o (swappable via dropdown)
Output Parser: Enforces JSON schema
Temp: 0.2 (consistent classification)

## 🔔 NOTIFICATION ROUTING
Slack alert fires when ANY of:
→ Confidence < 80%
→ Category = Refund Request
→ AI flagged needs_human_review

Alert @mentions the assigned agent.
Otherwise → Auto-Handled (no human needed).

## ⚠️ ERROR HANDLING
Catches unhandled workflow errors.
Logs to separate Airtable Errors table.
Sends Slack alert with failed node + error message.

## 👤 AGENT ASSIGNMENT
Looks up assigned agent from Agent Directory table.
Matches by classified category.
If primary unavailable → routes to backup.
Fallback: Team Lead if no agent found.
Slack mention is built safely (never a broken @tag).

options.systemMessage:
You are a customer support classifier for a SaaS company.

Analyze the customer message and classify it into exactly one category. Provide a confidence score, flag messages that need human review, and draft a professional response.

## Categories (choose exactly one):
- Billing — invoices, charges, payment methods, pricing, subscription changes
- Access — login issues, password resets, account lockouts, permission errors
- Scheduling — appointments, meetings, rescheduling, event cancellations
- Technical Support — bugs, errors, broken features, integration problems
- General Question — product info, how-to questions, general inquiries
- Refund Request — any mention of refund, money back, cancellation requesting money back

## Confidence Scoring:
- 90-100: Unambiguous, clearly fits one category
- 70-89: Likely correct but minor ambiguity exists
- 50-69: Multiple categories could reasonably apply
- Below 50: Unclear, vague, or highly complex

## Flag needs_human_review as TRUE when:
- Message contains angry, threatening, or abusive language
- Multiple categories apply with near-equal weight
- Message is too vague to classify with confidence
- Legal language or regulatory references appear
- Customer mentions escalation, complaint, lawsuit, or attorney
- Message references a prior unresolved issue

## Draft Response Rules:
- Professional, empathetic tone
- Acknowledge the specific issue mentioned
- Do NOT make promises about resolution timelines
- Do NOT approve refunds or account changes — only acknowledge and set expectations
- Keep under 150 words

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "category": "Billing",
  "confidence": 95,
  "needs_human_review": false,
  "reasoning": "Customer is asking about an unexpected charge on their invoice. Clear billing inquiry with no ambiguity.",
  "draft_response": "Thank you for reaching out about the charge on your account. I've forwarded your inquiry to our billing team, and someone will review your account details shortly. If you have your invoice number handy, please reply with it so we can look into this faster."
}
